paras: The Yangbay bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus yangbayensis) is a species of gecko found in Khánh Hòa Province, Vietnam.

This species can be distinguished from other Indo-Chinese speciesCyrtodactylus by the following characteristics: a snout-vent length averaging83.5 millimetres (3.29 in); dark spots on the head; 6–8 precloacal pores in males arranged in a chevron pattern; 18–20 subdigital lamellae under its first toe; 15–17 subdigital lamellae under its fourth toe; and a middle row of enlarged subcaudal scales.
This gecko inhabits monsoon evergreen forests of the Truong Son Mountain Range in Khanh Hoa province, Vietnam.
